messages:
Asha: Quick one — stuck at the airport, ETA for wheels up pushed. I need someone to cover primary for the 03:00-11:00 UTC chunk. I can still be reachable by phone but not confident taking pages until I'm on the ground.
Mike: I can take primary for 03:00-07:00 UTC if Sam can pick up 07:00-11:00.
Sam: I can do 07:00-11:00. Confirming I'm available and will shadow for the first 30m to sync.
Asha: Thanks — Mike, can you also own the active paging window if anything pops tonight? There was a P2 earlier but it looks stabilized (no current open incidents).
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2025-11-08T01:42:10Z — No active incidents in the last 2 hours. Pager status: quiet.
Priya: I'll be around for escalation if either of you need deeper infra access; reachable on DMs.
Mike: Ack. I'll update the rota and set myself as primary in PagerDuty for 03:00. Sam — please confirm you see the shadow pin after 07:00.
Sam: Saw it. I'll join the 07:00 handoff call. @Asha safe travels. :airplane:
Asha: Appreciate it. Leaving a short runbook snippet here for the team in case we get a perf regression on embeddings infra — steps I usually follow: ```1) Check host gpu-util & mem on infra-prod-embed-01/02
2) Tail /var/log/redwood/serve-runtime.log for the last 20m
3) Run quick sanity: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.prod/v1/embeds/test
4) If latency > 1s consistently, scale pool by +1 and notify infra on-call
5) If 5xx spike -> roll back last model rollout (see /runbooks/model-rollbacks)```
Mike: Good snippet — I'll pin a quick link in PD and put the runbook URL in the incident template. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/embeds-degrade
ops-bot: Reminder — canary health check for embeddings runs every 2m. Last canary: OK (p50=89ms p95=240ms).
Sam: One request — if you change pool sizing, please also flip the caching flag (cache-prefix-ttl) back to 30s after stabilization; we had a regression once when it stayed low. Leaving a note in the handoff.
Asha: Noted. Also leaving credentials note: KMS key rotation is in progress this week, but it's transparent for runtime. If you hit unexpected signature errors, escalate to Priya.
Mike: I'll create a quick checklist for the handoff DM: 1) Confirm pager pinned 2) Check canary 3) Validate runbook steps 4) Confirm escalation channel w/ Priya 5) Update incident template if anything changed.
Sam: Sounds good. I'll join the 07:00 sync and we can do a 5m verbal pass.
Asha: Thanks y'all — set my OOO on Slack until I land. Mike/Sam — consider this primary swap accepted. :thumbsup:
Mike: Accepted. Changing PD schedule now. Will post a short confirmation when done.
Mike: Done — PagerDuty updated. Primary: Mike 03:00-07:00 UTC, Primary Handoff: Sam 07:00-11:00 UTC, Secondary: Priya on-call for infra escalation. 
incident-bot: [CHANGE] PagerDuty assignment updated by Mike at 2025-11-08T02:55:03Z.
Priya: Copy that. If anything escalates ping #eng-infra as well.
Asha: Closing loop — thanks everyone. If anything urgent, call my mobile; otherwise I'll hop in after landing.
Sam: Roger. See you on the 07:00 handoff.
Mike: Night — I'll DM the 03:00 checklist in case we get any noisy alerts.
